schema.title: Schema
schema.description: source.json or target.json as the Map view holds it; null to start one.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: The schema's protocol: hl7, fhir, x12 or cda.

version.title: Version
version.description: The catalog release: the map's HL7 version (2.5), FHIR release (R4), X12 release (5010) or CDA release (R2).

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The HL7 messages (ADT_A01), FHIR resource types (Patient), X12 transaction sets (837P) or CDA document types (ContinuityofCareDocumentCCD) the schema must hold.

bundle.title: Bundle
bundle.description: Also hold the FHIR Bundle, imported before the rest (target.json, for a map that builds one).
